answer: Locks are published in vertex, expire in spiral, and juniper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 118 aliases hence needs 17 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3698 identities would post 3534 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
